model_definition.phasor_convention: Compatible with peak +j*omega*t: epsilon_complex has negative imaginary loss
model_definition.gamma_S_m: j*omega*epsilon0*epsilon_complex = sigma_i + j*omega*epsilon0*(epsilon_inf + sum Cole terms)
model_definition.double_count_warning: sigma_i is static ionic term, not the full frequency-dependent conductivity. Do not use sigma_i plus an independently tabulated full conductivity, or omit dispersive loss.

fat_infiltrated.tissue_species_status: mixed_source_generic_tissue_fit; not verified human-only at kHz

fat_not_infiltrated.tissue_species_status: mixed_source_generic_tissue_fit; not verified human-only at kHz

skeletal_muscle_generic.tissue_species_status: mixed_source_generic_tissue_fit; not verified human-only at kHz

source_population_and_conditions.animals: Excised tissue, mainly sheep with some pigs (II section4); Figure2a-h examples specifically bovine per caption
human_conditions: Human skin and tongue in vivo
source_population_and_conditions.small_human_material_frequency_limitatio: II section5.1 p2268: small human samples measured only above1MHz on two network analysers; no human-only kHz muscle/fat provenance established for generic fits
source_population_and_conditions.temperature: New experimental examples at body temperature; III Figure1 labels experimental data37C. Literature selected in fit can include other temperatures; a universal temperature correction is not provided.
source_population_and_conditions.site_specificity: Muscle measurements paravertebral; skin Figure2caption ventral forearm. Neither establishes human abdominalwall/intercostal/diaphragm values.

cuts: cut along fibres facing coaxial probe
muscle_orientation.limitation: Radial fringing field does not isolate true electric-field-parallel/perpendicular tensor eigenvalues
muscle_orientation.Table1_model: single scalar Muscle fit; no longitudinal/transverse pair
muscle_orientation.permissible_substitution_label: Generic mixed-source scalar skeletal-muscle proxy; isotropy is an explicit substitute, not validated fibre direction or diaphragm tissue

uncertainty.III_fit_method: Visually adjusted/intercorrelated/nonunique fit; not unique least-squares parameter identification
uncertainty.III_validity_caution: Model declared10Hz-100GHz; authors give stronger confidence above1MHz and caution at lower frequencies where data are sparse and uncertain
uncertainty.interpretation: These are broad experimental context, NOT carrier-specific confidence intervals or a formal probability distribution for a new subject.
uncertainty.electrode_polarization: II: effects below1kHz, significant below100Hz; residual permittivity errors below100Hz may be factor2-3. Do not transfer that low-frequency bound as a validated3kHz error bar.

carrier_usage.note: Root must evaluate the complex model separately at each actual frequency and preserve modelversion and rounding.

authoritative_implementation_crosscheck.scope: IFAC-CNR hosted authorized original-report transcription plus extended parameter database; not an original human-only measurement
authoritative_implementation_crosscheck.rounding_difference: Current database Muscle tau1=7.234ps vs journal Table1=7.23ps; Fat tau1=7.958ps vs7.96ps and tau3=159.16us vs159.15us. These are separately versioned alternatives, not silently blended.
authoritative_implementation_crosscheck.default_Fat_row: Corresponds to not-infiltrated model, not the infiltrated alternative

adoption_status: source_verified_candidate_only; root selects and evaluates; not adopted by evidence agent
whole_skin_warning: Dry/wet whole-skin models in the same table must not be assigned independently to both SC and dermis.
